cases.name: Death type fixture
cases.text: Whenever a creature dies, tap all untapped creatures that share a creature type with it.

cases.name: Target type fixture
cases.text: Tap target creature. Tap all untapped creatures that share a creature type with it.

cases.name: Type Mentor
cases.text: Target creature gains "Whenever this creature dies, tap all untapped creatures that share a creature type with it." until end of turn.

cases.name: Type Mentor
cases.text: Target creature gains "Whenever Type Mentor dies, tap all untapped creatures that share a creature type with it." until end of turn.

cases.name: Faces of the Past
cases.text: Whenever a creature dies, tap all untapped creatures that share a creature type with it or untap all tapped creatures that share a creature type with it.

cases.name: Target type fixture
cases.text: Tap target creature. Tap all untapped creatures that share a creature type with it or untap all tapped creatures that share a creature type with it.

cases.name: Type Mentor
cases.text: Target creature gains "Whenever this creature dies, tap all untapped creatures that share a creature type with it or untap all tapped creatures that share a creature type with it." until end of turn.

cases.name: Type Mentor
cases.text: Target creature gains "Whenever Type Mentor dies, tap all untapped creatures that share a creature type with it or untap all tapped creatures that share a creature type with it." until end of turn.

cases.name: Sweep contrast
cases.text: Tap all untapped artifacts or untap each tapped creature.
